title: Infrastructure (hôte)
description: Ressources de la machine : CPU, mémoire, disques, réseau (node_exporter).

targets.expr: sum by (mode) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"}[$__rate_interval])) / count(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", environment=~"$env", server=~"$server"}) * 100
